Last week saw significant discounts on several current Apple products, from 15% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the latest AirPods Max 2, but the deals aren't over yet. While the above markdowns are still valid, Amazon has just dropped the price of Apple's 2026 AirTag 2 to a new historical low — now available for as little as $20 each.

During last week's anniversary promotions, we reported several times on the historical low price for the AirTag 2, but if you missed it, don't worry — the price has now dropped again, hitting the lowest we've ever recorded.

Amazon is still selling a single AirTag 2 for $24, which since launch has matched the best price we've seen; however, the 4-pack has been reduced to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official price for a 4-pack is $99, and the per-unit price was already a better deal than the $29 single unit; now at roughly 20% off, this is a brand new historical low, with each AirTag 2 coming in at just $20 here.

During last week's major retailer's anniversary event, the previous 4-pack deal price of $90 was pretty much available steadily throughout the week, but Amazon's historical low this time is different — no one knows when the price will go back up.

We've previously compared the differences between the previous-generation AirTag and this year's AirTag 2 — you can revisit it here — but here are the key highlights:

  • Precision Finding range is 1.5 times farther than before
  • Speaker is up to 50% louder than the original
  • Can "hear the AirTag 2 from 1.5x the distance"
  • "Industry-first set of protections against malicious tracking"

AirTag 2 to gain new features soon

AirTag 2 is down to $20 each, just in time before next month's launch of iOS 27 and watchOS 27. There's also good news for Apple Watch users: the Find My app has gained Precision Finding support. This means you can now use your Apple Watch, with on-screen arrows and specific distance information, to locate an AirTag.

watchOS 27 will also unify the Find My experience within a single app. Previously, the Find My experience on Apple Watch was split into three separate app icons (People, Items, Devices), scattered across the app list or grid.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 brings a new design and interface tweaks to the Find My app, making it easier to track people and items.

Seeing all this, now is the perfect time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at this price point.

More Apple deals this week:

  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
